description: This file defines the AboutActivity class for an Android application, which manages the 'About' screen with tabs for credits, contributions, and licenses. It includes UI setup, branding application, and fragment management.

classes.name: AboutActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays information about the app, with tabbed sections for credits, contributions, and licenses.

classes.name: TabsStateAdapter
classes.description: A FragmentStateAdapter that provides the appropriate fragment for each tab in the AboutActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and configures the tab layout with fragments.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the activity UI elements based on the provided color.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment instance based on the tab position.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation when the up button is pressed, closing the activity.
